newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NSA buys 35 pct of media group.
newsitem.headline: NSA buys 35 pct of media group.

text.p: NSA Investments Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to acquire a 35 percent equity interest in the Parallel Media Group International Ltd (PMG) for 30 million rand and provide it with 15 million rand in shareholders loans.
PMG is an international media and promotions group with offices in London, New York, Seoul and Kuala Lumpur and a strong presence in South Africa.

It owns 50 percent of NBC Super Sports, which supplies sports programmes to European and Asian networks and owns and manages global sporting events. It also pioneered the creation of international broadcast programming for advertisers.
NSA said the rationale for the investment is its belief that tourism is a high growth industry.
"NSA is seeking to expand its exposure to the tourism industry generally," it said.
The company added that had the acquisition been effective on July 1, it would not have had a material effect on its earnings per share for the year to June 30 or its net asset value at that date.
